fields.name: Merge
fields.evidence: ecl::splitscreen::GoalSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x84FED0) ends with *goal = cVar7; goal[1] = cVar17 (only written when changed). cVar7 becomes 1 (merge the screens) when there are no split reasons (SplitReasonsSingleton+0 == 0), when SplitReasons+2 (merge reasons) != 0, when force-merge focus is set, when a player has no character or is not in the render view, etc. Default 1 (macOS default constructor: mov w17,#1; strh w17,[x23]); live 0x01 in single player. Read back at the start of the same function (if goal[0] != 1 the 0x4 split reason bit is masked).

fields.name: field_1
fields.evidence: GoalSystem::Update writes goal[1] = (split reasons masked to 0x30 only, i.e. only the per-player bits 0x10/0x20 set) && !merge. The meaning of those two reason bits (set by EoCClient.dll+0x83DB60 per player) is not established. Default 0, live 0.

open_questions: Meaning of byte 1 (a partial/soft split goal?) and the exact names; both are ours.
